admin.form.affiliate.title: Affiliate Product Setting
admin.form.affiliate.intro: Affiliate products only send members to external partner links. Timeblock does not run in-site checkout or create in-site payment flow for this surface.
admin.form.affiliate.safe_note: This product card must be clearly marked as an external affiliate link. It does not collect member internal points and does not checkout inside Timeblock.
admin.form.affiliate.delete_intro: Soft-delete this product from the public Shop and the normal Admin list while preserving the database record and audit trail.
admin.form.redeem.title: Redemption Product Setting
admin.form.redeem.intro: This shop only uses platform internal points to redeem products. Manage inventory, redemption cost, and fulfillment. Internal points are not cash, not a wallet, and cannot be withdrawn.
admin.form.redeem.safe_note: After a member submits a redemption, an order is created with delivery details. Admins update fulfillment in Redemption Orders.
admin.form.label.delete_confirm: I confirm that I want to delete this product.
admin.form.gallery.product_status: Up to 5 images. Product images are compressed before storage.
admin.error.affiliate_delete_not_found: The affiliate product was not found or is already deleted.
admin.participants.title: Event Participants
admin.participants.intro: Review free participation, internal point tickets, share verification, random draws, and gift fulfillment status.
admin.participants.draw_intro_suffix: participants. The system only draws from verified participation records and writes an audit log with Python secrets.SystemRandom.
admin.participants.announcement_placehol: Winners have been published. Admin will contact winners for gift delivery.
